critical_code_review_comments: Avatar.jsx: the entire avatar image button (data-testid='avatar-image-btn') still calls replay() on click. That's fine functionally, but its aria-label='Replay greeting' plus the existence of 'avatar-tap-to-hear' means there are effectively two replay affordances; only the explicit named 'avatar-replay' testid was removed. If the intent was to fully remove replay UX, consider dropping the onClick from the avatar image too.
Projects.jsx: link container uses onClick stopPropagation — verified working (repo click does not narrate). Good pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: avatar-replay testid absent (0), avatar-bubble absent (0), avatar-mute + avatar-language-toggle present, 7 languages listed (english, hindi, tamil, telugu, kannada, odia, bengali), no hinglish. 3 project cards render (01,02,03). Card 03 has no demo/paper (verified count=0). Clicking project-card-03 fires exactly one POST /api/tts network request; clicking the repo link inside a card does NOT fire /api/tts (stopPropagation confirmed). Backend regression: GET /api/ -> 200; POST /api/tts with the AI Photo Booth text -> 200 with audio_base64 length 213052. Only failure: Card 01 hrefs mismatch — see action item.
